name: idle-mod
description: Turns Claude Code's wait state into a live briefing on your own project: vulnerabilities, unpushed commits, stale branches, TODO/FIXME debt. Local only, zero tokens, and the fix is one button away.

headless.title: Run where nothing is drawn
headless.description: In claude -p, SDK and CI sessions, stop Claude's commits that may hold a secret and share the session's findings with the other sessions on the project. Git and files only, no network.
